title: Latam launches Mega Promo with flights to Porto Alegre
seoTitle: Latam launches Mega Promo with flights to Porto Alegre
subtitle: Campaign offers airfare and packages with discounts and up to 12 interest‑free installments.
excerpt: Latam Airlines has started a new edition of its Mega Promo, offering reduced‑price tickets for domestic and international flights.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Latam Airlines launched a new edition of its discount campaign, Mega Promo, which has attracted public attention by featuring air tickets at special prices for a variety of destinations. Among the offers that generate interest are domestic flights, such as to Porto Alegre, as well as options for international trips, like the Caribbean and Europe, with easy payment terms.

Featured domestic tickets

Mega Promo from Latam offers domestic fares starting at R$ 151.44 per segment. Highlighted routes include flights between São Paulo/Guarulhos and Uberaba at that price, or 3,577 Latam Pass miles plus taxes. For travelers heading to the south of the country, tickets between Curitiba and Porto Alegre start at R$ 169.72. Other options include São Paulo/Guarulhos to Juiz de Fora from R$ 181.44, and Curitiba to Rio de Janeiro/Galeão from R$ 226.72.

Domestic ticket offers are valid for travel starting October 1 2026, with periods varying by selected route.

Opportunities abroad

For those planning international trips, the campaign presents fares from R$ 1,435 round‑trip, taxes included. In South America, flights between Rio de Janeiro/Galeão and Buenos Aires/Ezeiza start at R$ 1,506.78, and to Montevideo from R$ 1,562.43. There are also tickets between São Paulo/Guarulhos and Lima from R$ 1,665.99, and to Mendoza from R$ 2,163.78.

The Caribbean is also covered, with round‑trip flights between Brasília and Punta Cana starting at R$ 2,947.95. The site Melhores Destinos found tickets to Costa Rica from R$ 2,217 departing from São Paulo, Brasília and other cities. Aruba is available for R$ 2,371, Cancun for R$ 2,535, Punta Cana for R$ 2,615 and Montego Bay (Jamaica) from R$ 2,778. For the United States, Latam offers round‑trip flights from São Paulo/Guarulhos to Orlando starting at R$ 2,916.62, Los Angeles at R$ 3,171.44 and New York/JFK at R$ 3,210.09. There are also flights between Rio de Janeiro/Galeão and Boston from R$ 3,487.69.

In Europe, options appear between São Paulo/Guarulhos and Amsterdam starting at R$ 3,706.96, and between Fortaleza and Lisbon from R$ 3,843.49. The promotion also includes flights between Rio de Janeiro/Galeão and Madrid starting at R$ 3,975.92, and Barcelona from R$ 4,236.36. International offers are for departures between September and December 2026 and, on some European routes, between January and March 2027.

Payment terms and deadline

Ticket purchases in Latam’s Mega Promo can be split into up to 10 interest‑free installments on any credit card. Customers with a Latam Pass Itaú card can divide payment into up to 12 interest‑free installments. Additionally, the campaign offers an extra discount of up to 10% on selected routes for purchases made through the Latam app. Note that Mega Promo ends next Monday, August 31.

Other campaign benefits

Beyond air tickets, Mega Promo includes discounts of up to 50% on flight‑and‑hotel packages, which can also be paid in up to 12 interest‑free installments. Customers can receive up to 50% off the redemption of these packages with Latam Pass miles, with the possibility of combining miles and cash. For accommodations booked through a partnership with Booking.com, the discount can reach 35% at selected hotels, with payment in up to six interest‑free installments. The campaign also offers travel insurance with up to 70% off using the coupon PROMOLATAM, and car rentals with reductions up to 15%, while allowing the accumulation of Latam Pass miles and qualifying points.
